_comment: Companion to `reexport_default_import_of_external_cjs` (https://github.com/rolldown/rolldown/issues/10069). Only cjs regressed there: iife/umd keep the external alive as a factory parameter, so their `__toESM` never went missing, and esm keeps the import syntax and needs no interop at all. This pins that the cjs fix leaves all three alone — it also walks the iife/umd renderer and the chunk deconflicter, which the fix touches. Not executed: iife/umd would need `output.globals` for a node builtin.
